page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This configuration does not include any graphics processing units (GPUs).
The instance is equipped with 403 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed local disk access directly attached to the host. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-standard-8-lssd balances dedicated compute resources with high-speed local storage, making it suitable for workloads requiring fast temporary disk space without the overhead of network-attached storage. Appropriate workloads include general-purpose computing, local database hosting, development environments, and applications requiring moderate memory-to-CPU ratios alongside fast scratch disk space.
